page.title: WearMask | Service Statement
page.description: Read the WearMask service and privacy statement to understand our local browser-based operation.

hero.title: Service Statement
hero.description: By using the WearMask detection service, you agree to the following terms. If you do not agree, please stop using this service immediately.

service.title: 1. Service Content
service.body: This service is provided as a web page. Simply open the page to access AI-based real-time mask detection and alerts.

privacy.title: 2. Privacy Protection
privacy.collectionBody: To provide detection, you must authorize camera access. WearMask analyzes video frames locally on your device and never collects facial recognition data.
privacy.storageBody: Powered by WebAssembly, all computations are performed locally in your browser. We do not upload any video, images, or audio to servers. Your data never leaves your device.

declaration.title: 3. Declaration & Warranty
declaration.body: You agree to use this service in compliance with applicable laws and are responsible for your content sources. WearMask provides this technical tool based on your instructions and is not liable for legal consequences arising from your use.

notice.title: 4. Notice & Updates
notice.body: We may update this statement to meet policy or service requirements. Please check this page regularly for the latest information.
